item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":35,"end_unit":35,"fact_summary":"The Ministry of Justice organized a workshop on access to justice for victims under the National Human Rights Strategy, attended by 30 first-instance court presidents and Judicial Inspection Department staff, and provided training on juvenile justice, women's rights, violence against women, children with disabilities, trafficking, corruption, and climate issues.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.7","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Institutional activity reported during the covered period, with relevance to 2023 through July 2023 training activity.","ruler_attribution":"Government ministry action during el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential direction is specified.","limitations":["The source is a government report and does not independently evaluate outcomes or implementation quality."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":35,"end_unit":35,"fact_summary":"Between August 2020 and July 2023, the Ministry of the Interior held seven UNODC-coordinated training courses for officials on crime-scene management, evidence preservation, victim interviewing, gang-member interviewing, and forged-document detection in migrant-smuggling and trafficking cases.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.7","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers August 2020-July 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Interior Ministry implementation during el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential role is specified.","limitations":["Training activity does not establish reduced abuse or successful prosecutions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":35,"end_unit":35,"fact_summary":"In 2022, the national committee combating irregular migration and human trafficking conducted 70 training courses for 1,940 representatives of ministries and other official bodies.","question_ids":["3B.7","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The event occurred in 2022 and informs institutional capacity entering 2023.","ruler_attribution":"National committee activity during el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential role is specified.","limitations":["The source provides no independent assessment of effectiveness."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":35,"end_unit":36,"fact_summary":"Egypt's Constitution and criminal legislation establish equality before the law, prohibit discrimination on listed grounds, criminalize religious bullying, and impose imprisonment and fines for discriminatory acts or incitement to religious discrimination, including by public officials.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.7","4B.7","6B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Legal framework in force during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Constitutional and legislative framework administered under el-Sisi's presidency; the document does not attribute enactment to him personally.","limitations":["Formal legal protections do not demonstrate consistent enforcement or remedy."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":36,"end_unit":36,"fact_summary":"The State reported measures to combat prejudice and stigmatization against migrants, build knowledge of migrants' rights, and enable migrants to practice religion, express opinions, participate in community activities, and access education, health care, jobs, social security, and community organizations.","question_ids":["3B.7","6B.3","6B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Reported government policy during the period covered by the submission, relevant to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"State policy reported under el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential direction is specified.","limitations":["These are government assertions without independent verification or quantified outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":36,"end_unit":37,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported that foreign workers could enter the labor market under legal restrictions; in 2020, 29,137 foreigners received first-time work permits, 33,242 permits were renewed, and 18,332 people working unlawfully regularized their status.","question_ids":["5B.4","6B.3","6B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Quantitative results are from 2020 and therefore provide historical context rather than a 2023 outcome.","ruler_attribution":"Labor-market administration during el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential role is specified.","limitations":["The figures predate 2023 and do not show distributional effects or current enforcement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":37,"end_unit":37,"fact_summary":"The government reported equal access to health services for migrants and foreigners, including health-insurance access subject to reciprocity, and described 22 mobile reproductive-health units operating in five governorates that benefited 2,792 Syrian migrants.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Programs began before 2023; the report presents them as continuing institutional provision relevant to the period.","ruler_attribution":"Ministry of Health administration under el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential direction is specified.","limitations":["The source does not provide 2023 uptake, funding, or independent quality evaluation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":37,"end_unit":37,"fact_summary":"Mental-health services were integrated into 40 primary-health-care units in areas with high refugee concentrations, with staff capacity-building and expanded health campaigns for refugees and asylum-seekers, including hepatitis C and anti-polio initiatives.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Institutional measures reported as operating before and into the period; exact 2023 implementation date is not stated.","ruler_attribution":"Ministry of Health programs under el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential direction is specified.","limitations":["No outcome data or independent verification is provided."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":37,"end_unit":37,"fact_summary":"The Ministry of Health launched a 2020-2021 regional action plan for refugees and migrants intended to provide quality health care, reduce morbidity and premature deaths, refer patients to Ministry hospitals, and develop hospitals in governorates with high refugee concentrations.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The plan dates to 2020-2021 and is historical context for 2023, not a 2023 launch.","ruler_attribution":"Ministry policy during el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential direction is specified.","limitations":["The source states aims and implementation efforts but does not demonstrate achieved outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":37,"end_unit":37,"fact_summary":"During the COVID-19 response, the government reported equal access to health and medical services for foreigners, generally unrestricted movement subject to universal precautions, temporary suspension of deportation or forced return of irregular migrants, and cooperation with migrant and refugee organizations.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","6B.6","6B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"COVID-19 measures concern an earlier crisis and provide context for institutional crisis management entering 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Government response during el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential decision is specified.","limitations":["The source is self-reported and does not quantify coverage, compliance, or avoided harm."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":38,"end_unit":38,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported that children of migrant workers, whether documented or undocumented, were to receive access to schools on an equal basis with Egyptian children.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Policy reported as applicable during the covered period; the source does not provide a 2023 enrollment result.","ruler_attribution":"Government policy during el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential direction is specified.","limitations":["The supplied text does not establish actual access or enrollment rates."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":38,"end_unit":38,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported that the Labour Code exempts workers from court fees in Labour Code disputes and that indigent persons may receive court-fee exemptions and legal assistance through judicial committees and legal-assistance offices.","question_ids":["3B.4","6B.2","6B.3"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Legal provisions in force during the period, though some cited statutes predate 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Legislative and judicial-access framework administered under el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential role is specified.","limitations":["The source does not show usage rates, timeliness, or independence of the assistance mechanisms."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":40,"end_unit":40,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported adopting a model contract for domestic workers, applying skill-certification rules, allowing social-insurance coverage and trade-union formation, while a bill was being drafted to regulate hours, holidays, wages, insurance, inspections, complaints, placement agencies, child labor, minimum wages, and penalties.","question_ids":["5B.4","6B.3","6B.8","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Existing measures and a bill-in-progress were reported during the covered period; the bill was not yet enacted in the supplied text.","ruler_attribution":"Government and parliamentary policy under el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential direction is specified.","limitations":["The proposed bill remained under preparation, and implementation of existing protections is not independently assessed."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":40,"end_unit":40,"fact_summary":"The National Council for Women formed a national working group on domestic workers, ran awareness campaigns, taught workers reporting mechanisms, and reported that penalties against abusive employers were made public.","question_ids":["3B.7","6B.3","6B.8","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Institutional measures reported as operating during the covered period.","ruler_attribution":"National Council for Women activity under el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential direction is specified.","limitations":["The source does not quantify complaints, penalties, or resulting improvements."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":41,"end_unit":41,"fact_summary":"The Ministry of Labour and Migration established a pre-departure training centre and six migration-counselling offices, and created an online system linking labour offices with the ministry and labour ministries in other Arab States.","question_ids":["5B.6","6B.4","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Institutional measures reported during the covered period; exact dates are not supplied.","ruler_attribution":"Ministry implementation under el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential direction is specified.","limitations":["The source does not provide staffing, budget, uptake, or outcome evidence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":41,"end_unit":41,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported that labour offices abroad reviewed contracts and visas, blocked categories of domestic work considered high-risk, and sought to verify job offers and promote social and health protection for migrant workers.","question_ids":["5B.4","6B.3","6B.8","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Reported as an operating policy during the period covered.","ruler_attribution":"Labour administration under el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential direction is specified.","limitations":["The source does not identify the number of blocked offers or independently verify protection outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":41,"end_unit":41,"fact_summary":"The government reported regulating migration-service companies and publishing lists of licensed placement firms and prohibited firms; the supplied figures list 850 licensed companies, 345 prohibited firms, 1,503 regular firms, and 426 firms with which interaction was prohibited.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.5","6B.7","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Quantitative administrative status reported during the covered period; the precise reference date is not stated.","ruler_attribution":"Government regulatory administration under el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential direction is specified.","limitations":["The figures are self-reported and the category totals are not explained in the supplied text."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":42,"end_unit":42,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported implementing two migration and labor-mobility projects with European partners, including the Egyptian-German job, migration and reintegration centre and the EU co-funded THAMM project, alongside training and employment measures for young people and reintegration support for returnees.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.9","6B.6","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Projects were reported as implemented during the covered period; the source does not provide 2023 outcome data.","ruler_attribution":"Government cooperation under el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential direction is specified.","limitations":["The source describes projects and aims but not independently measured results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":43,"end_unit":43,"fact_summary":"Egypt's legal system provides Egyptians living abroad the right to stand for election and vote, with a designated quota on electoral lists.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Legal framework reported as applicable during the period; no 2023 election administration result is provided.","ruler_attribution":"Legal framework administered under el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential direction is specified.","limitations":["The fact concerns formal rights and does not establish contestability, administration quality, or actual participation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-08a8e399ce77ae66","start_unit":44,"end_unit":44,"fact_summary":"Between January 2020 and October 2023, authorities recorded 1,884 cases involving criminal networks engaged in irregular migration and trafficking, including 1,194 irregular-migration cases and 654 human-trafficking cases; by 30 September 2023, the State Prosecution Office had opened investigations into 67 trafficking incidents, including sexual exploitation, forced labour, and other exploitation.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.7","3B.9","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly includes January-October 2023 and investigations through September 2023.","ruler_attribution":"State prosecution and law-enforcement activity during el-Sisi's presidency; no personal presidential direction is specified.","limitations":["Case counts demonstrate enforcement activity and continuing harm but do not establish conviction rates, victim remedy, or causal presidential responsibility."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied material is a single government periodic report and largely describes formal laws, programs, and administrative claims rather than independently verified 2023 outcomes.","No supplied fact materially addresses nuclear risk, interstate war, arms control, military procurement, macroeconomic stability, ruler truthfulness, personal enrichment, or independent accountability of the president."]}
